patterns.title: Windows Update failed to install an update
regex: Installation Failure: Windows failed to install the following update with error (?P<detail>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)
patterns.summary: Windows Update tried to install an update and failed with {detail}.

remediation.detail: The code in the finding explains the usual reason. 0x800f0922 and 0x800f081f are common servicing failures.

remediation.action: Repair the servicing stack and component store
Check free space and pending restarts
remediation.detail: Low disk space or a pending restart blocks many updates.

patterns.title: Windows Update failed to download
patterns.summary: Windows Update could not download content.

remediation.action: Check connectivity to the update service
remediation.detail: DNS, proxy and firewall rules for Windows Update or the Delivery Optimization groups.
Downloads are staged on the system drive.
0x8024xxxx codes are Windows Update agent errors. The finding shows the meaning when it is a well-known one.

patterns.title: Servicing (CBS) error
patterns.summary: The Windows servicing stack logged an error-level failure {detail}. (CBS.log also records many harmless failures at Info level; those are ignored.)

remediation.action: Provide a source if files are missing
remediation.detail: 0x800f081f means the source files were not found; point DISM at matching Windows media.
